#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; in vec4 position; uniform mat4 ProjectionMatrix; out vec2 fragCoord; void main(void) { gl_Position = ProjectionMatrix * vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(position.z, position.w); }

#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; uniform sampler2D pointTexture; in vec2 fragCoord; uniform vec4 inputColor; const float radius = 0.5; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { vec2 pointTexCoord = vec2(fragCoord.x, fragCoord.y); float alpha = texture(pointTexture, pointTexCoord).a; if (alpha == 0.0) discard; float distX = abs(center.x - fragCoord.x); float pixelDistX = fwidth(distX) * 1.0; float smoothAlphaX = 1.0 - clamp((distX - (radius - pixelDistX)) / pixelDistX, 0.0, 1.0); float distY = abs(center.y - fragCoord.y); float pixelDistY = fwidth(distY) * 1.0; float smoothAlphaY = 1.0 - clamp((distY - (radius - pixelDistY)) / pixelDistY, 0.0, 1.0); if (smoothAlphaX == 0.0 || smoothAlphaY == 0.0) discard; FragColor = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, alpha * smoothAlphaX * smoothAlphaY * inputColor.a); }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; in vec4 position; out vec2 vUV; void main(void) { gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0); vUV = position.zw; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; in vec2 vUV; uniform sampler2D StrokeTexture; uniform sampler2D MaskBitmap; uniform vec4 inputColor; uniform vec2 viewSize; uniform int isSetReferenceBitmap; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float strokeAlpha = texture(StrokeTexture, vUV).a; if (isSetReferenceBitmap == 1) { vec2 grainTexCoord = vec2(gl_FragCoord.x / viewSize.x, gl_FragCoord.y / viewSize.y); vec4 color = texture(MaskBitmap, grainTexCoord); strokeAlpha *= (1.0 - color.r); } if (strokeAlpha > 0.0) FragColor = vec4(inputColor.rgb, strokeAlpha); else discard; }
